review_candidates.title: Sales Engineers for Cairo&Alexandria
review_candidates.description: Company Description HCP is a provider of generators and heavy equipment solutions, serving industrial and commercial clients with reliable power and machinery products. The company focuses on delivering technically sound, cost-effective solutions that support continuous operations and long-term performance. HCP works closely with customers to understand their operational needs and offers tailored equipment configurations, installation support, and after-sales service. The organization values technical excellence, customer satisfaction, and safety in all projects. Team members are encouraged to contribute expertise, collaborate across functions, and grow within a dynamic, field-oriented environment. Role Description The Sales Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo, Egypt, covering customers in Cairo and Alexandria. The Sales Engineer will identify and qualify leads, meet with prospective and existing customers, and propose generators and heavy equipment solutions that meet technical and commercial requirements. Daily tasks include preparing and delivering technical and commercial offers, conducting site visits, coordinating with internal technical teams, and providing pre- and post-sales technical support. The role also involves maintaining strong customer relationships, handling inquiries, following up on quotations, and supporting negotiations to close deals. The Sales Engineer will be expected to maintain accurate sales reports, monitor market trends and competitor activities, and ensure a professional representation of HCP at client meetings, events, and demonstrations. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering skills, including solution design, equipment selection, and technical proposal preparation. Candidates should possess solid Technical Support capabilities, such as troubleshooting, basic diagnostics, and coordination with service teams. Candidates should possess effective Communication and Customer Service skills, including clear presentation, active listening, and relationship management. Candidates should possess core Sales skills, including prospecting, pipeline management, negotiation, and deal closing. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering field is preferred. Experience with generators, heavy equipment, or industrial power systems is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site, conduct field visits, and travel between Cairo and Alexandria as needed. Strong problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and commitment to safety and compliance. Proficiency

review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Valves Sales Engineer Location: Cairo, Egypt Employment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for a Valves Sales Engineer to join our growing team and take responsibility for developing sales of industrial valves and related mechanical products within the water, wastewater, HVAC, and MEP sectors. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with commercial ability and is comfortable working with contractors, consultants, end users, and procurement teams. Key Responsibilities * Develop and maintain relationships with contractors, consultants, end users, and engineering companies. * Identify new sales opportunities and actively develop the valve sales pipeline. * Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable valve solutions. * Prepare technical and commercial quotations. * Review project specifications, BOQs, and tender documents. * Coordinate with suppliers to obtain technical information, pricing, and lead times. * Follow up on quotations and negotiate with customers to close sales. * Conduct regular customer visits and project follow-ups. * Track ongoing projects and identify opportunities at an early stage. * Support customers with technical product information and application guidance. * Maintain accurate sales records and regularly report on pipeline and opportunities. * Work closely with the engineering and procurement teams to ensure smooth execution of orders. Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 1–3 years of experience in technical sales, preferably in valves, pumps, piping, HVAC, water & wastewater, or MEP. * Good understanding of industrial valves and piping systems. * Ability to read and understand technical specifications, BOQs, and drawings. * Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. * Good command of English, both written and spoken. * Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills. * Ability to work independently and develop new business opportunities. * Willingness to travel for customer and project visits. What We Offer * Competitive salary + performance-based commission. * Opportunity to work with international valve products. * Exposure to major water, wastewater, HVAC, and MEP projects. * Opportunity for professional and commercial growth within a growing engineering company. * A role with significant responsibility for developing and expanding the valve business. How to Apply Interested candidates should send their CV with the subject line: “Valves Sales Engineer – Application”
